text:
Ava (support): Heads up — AcmeCorp flagged a month-end mismatch: dashboard total 1,024,512 tokens vs invoice 1,156,720 tokens. They finished reconciliation and are asking for a breakdown.
Miguel (finance): Yikes. Can you share the invoice id and the account id?
Ava (support): Invoice #INV-20260331-ACME, acct acme-001. Customer says line items show 'standard' plan but dashboard attributes ~30k tokens to 'enterprise' in the final CSV.
Nora (acct-mgr): I saw a note from onboarding that they had a temporary plan override for a trial event on Mar 29. That shouldn't affect April finalization though. @Priya any quick ideas? :thinking_face:
Priya (billing-engineer): Running a quick check against meteringsvc. Can you paste the invoice snapshot time?
Ava (support): The invoice generation log says cutoff_ts=1679913600 (2026-03-27T00:00:00Z) and finalized_ts=1733007400. Customer claims they see different row totals in the dashboard export at 2026-03-31T23:59:59 local.
Priya (billing-engineer): Hmm — that mismatch smells like a cutoff-window vs dashboard-export-timezone thing. I'll run queries.
Priya (billing-engineer): Query I ran: ```sql
SELECT plan_tier, SUM(token_count) AS tokens
FROM meter_events
WHERE account_id='acme-001' AND event_ts < to_timestamp(1679913600)
GROUP BY plan_tier;
```
Priya (billing-engineer): Results show ~1,125,000 tokens on 'standard', but there are ~31k tokens tagged 'enterprise' with event_ts between 1679906400 and 1679910000 (an hour crossing).
Tom (platform): That hour window coincides with a scheduled plan-override backfill job we kicked off for a different tenant on 2026-03-26 23:00 UTC. There was a short bug where the job's account scoping logic used an incorrect tenant_id filter for ~600s.
Miguel (finance): So the backfill wrote plan_tier='enterprise' on some ACME events? That would inflate the invoice line allocation.
Priya (billing-engineer): Exactly. The meter ingestion retained the modified plan_tier and the invoice job used meter_events as truth. Dashboard export (which queries billing_snapshot table created earlier) used pre-backfill snapshot so it shows 'standard'.
Nora (acct-mgr): Acme is asking for a corrected invoice. What's the impact and fix plan?
Priya (billing-engineer): Impact: ~31,208 tokens misattributed to 'enterprise'. Unit price diff between tiers is $0.0006/token which equals ~$18.72. CPU: very small but customer expects accuracy.
Ava (support): Customer asks for an explanation + corrected PDF. I'll draft a note.
Tom (platform): Immediate fix: roll back the erroneous backfill changes for acme-001 (we have WAL + audit logs). I've created a hotfix branch to only target affected account ids.
Priya (billing-engineer): After rollback, we'll re-run invoice finalization job in dry-run mode and validate counts against dashboard snapshot. I will generate a delta report.
Miguel (finance): If numbers match, we'll issue a corrected invoice/credit for $18.72. Finance needs journal entry details.
Ava (support): I'll inform the customer timeline: ETA 4 hours for rollback + verification, then corrected invoice within 24 hours. Sending initial message now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Nora (acct-mgr): Please also offer a one-time credit for the confusion, maybe $50? Approve? :money_with_wings:
Miguel (finance): Approve one-time courtesy credit up to $50. Document it in the invoice notes.
Priya (billing-engineer): Update: rollback completed at 1733006800, re-run dry-run finalization shows dashboard/invoice tokens both 1,024,512. Delta report attached to internal ticket.
OpsBot: internal-ticket #BILL-6023 created by Priya, severity: medium, tags: backfill, plan-override, acme-001.
Priya (billing-engineer): I'll push corrected invoice payload to accounting queue, flag for manual approval.
Ava (support): Sending customer update: "We've identified a backfill bug that temporarily mis-tagged ~31k tokens. We've reverted the change, validated counts, and will issue a corrected invoice + $50 courtesy credit. Full report and ticket #BILL-6023 attached."
Nora (acct-mgr): Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick fix — please confirm when credit applied."
Miguel (finance): I'll sign off on the corrected invoice at 1733008000 once ledger entry is ready.
Ava (support): Marking thread resolved after invoice posted. Will follow up if they escalate. :white_check_mark:
